newsitem.title: USA: TCI's Liberty Media CEO Barton resigns.
newsitem.headline: TCI's Liberty Media CEO Barton resigns.

text.p: Tele-Communications Inc said on Tuesday Peter Barton, executive vice president of TCI and president and chief executive officer of its Liberty Media Corp, resigned to start a new venture.
He would be replaced by Robert Bennett, now the executive vice president and chief financial officer of Liberty Media, the company said.

"Peter has been extraordinarily successful at Liberty, building that company into the powerful and strategically positioned asset that it is today," TCI Chairman John Malone said. "Dob Bennett is a talented executive and Liberty is poised to continue its growth under his leadership."
Barton said he was leaving to develop software businesses through his own independent entity.
Robert, or Dob, Bennett, has served as Liberty's principal financial officer since the company's inception in 1990, it said. He has been employed at TCI since 1987.
The company said there had been no decision yet on who would replace Bennett as CFO.
